description: Episode vessels are born by mkepisode, never mkdir. A PreToolUse hook on Bash refuses a command that would create a new directory directly under $MIADI_CHRONICLE_ROOT and returns the mkepisode invocation — with the --adopt repair for a directory that already holds work. Creating directories inside an episode that already exists is not blocked, and a host with no MIADI_CHRONICLE_ROOT is not guarded at all. Hooks load at session start and do not hot-swap: restart Claude Code after changing this file. A Stop hook (address-check.mjs) sends the agent back once when its reply names an episode or prints a circle id without its @miadi/reference-ui address (miadi-chronicle://563, miadi-circle://circle:…), jgwill/miadi-orchestration-kit#103.
